respuesta.pregunta: In traffic-gate-api latest, what does the overall architecture diagram show? Which components are in it and how are they connected to each other?
respuesta.respuesta:
I can't answer this from the latest documentation. None of the documents describe the contents of the overall architecture diagram, so I can't say which components it shows or how they connect.

Here is what the documentation does cover. The application has three main modules, Job, Blacklist and Whitelist, each exposing web services [traffic-gate-api/latest/guide/sections/arch.md:L5-L11]. There is also a separate sequence diagram for the POST /whitelist flow, with these participants: RetailHub-Job, Traffic-Gate, MySQL-DB, Vegeta-API and RetailHub-BigQ [traffic-gate-api/latest/guide/sections/processes.md:L29-L51]. That one only covers the enqueueing process, not the overall architecture.
